notes: Market Street downtown, 1960 sheet 1: Market from Sixth/Taylor to Fourth/Stockton, the north grid (Taylor, Mason, Anna Lane, Opal Pl, Latham Pl) above it and the slanted South of Market grid below (Fifth, Sixth, Fourth; Stevenson, Jessie, Mission, Minna, Natoma, Howard, Tehama, Clementina, Mint, Mary, Holland, Tulip). Every printed block is a polygon; everything else in the box is street. No open polygons: the box holds no ground without an outline of its own. How the corners were read: each block's paper was taken from the scan (ink is darker than 138), its convex outline found, and each side pushed out to the centre of the outermost ink px of the block's own thin line, measured along that side (thin lines are 3-4 px; median push 3.5 px; where a heavy border lies on the line the push is the median thin-line width, 3.5 px, so the corner sits on the thin line's outer edge, not the heavy line's); street paper inside that outline (alleys running into a block) is cut out. Then checked by eye on 4x-8x ruled close-ups and the labels picture. Sides sit within about 1 px of the printed line's outer edge (half the edge px on ink, half one px out, from the staircase of slanted lines). Corrected by hand after measuring: the Clementina face of the Tehama-Clementina block west of Fifth has a 3 px step at (2056-2058, 4760-4762); the Stevenson face of the Market-Stevenson block between Fifth and Sixth has a 3-4 px step at (1780-1782, 4305-4310) where the heavy border meets it; the sharp tips of the triangles at (2073, 3948) and (1560, 4341) end where the ink ends. Market Street: from the block ends of the north grid (Opal Pl triangle hypotenuse, e.g. (1578, 4325)-(1715, 4218)) to the north-west side of the Market-Stevenson blocks (e.g. (1618, 4352)-(1858, 4168)): 43 px between the two polygon sides measured square to the street (about 41 px of street paper, about 115 ft). Its name MARKET ST. is printed in it. NO heavy zoning border runs in Market in this box: the heavy border runs in STEVENSON St, the alley one block south-east of Market and parallel to it (between the Market-Stevenson blocks and the Stevenson-Jessie blocks: x 1480-1655 y 4680-4400, x 1655-1905 y 4400-4215, then down Fifth St (1905, 4215)-(1960, 4265), then x 1960-2200 along Stevenson again, across Fourth St in a V at (2163, 4005)-(2215, 4062), then north-east between the blocks at (2150-2300, 3900-3990) and (2203-2420, 3900-4045)). Stevenson there is drawn as thin line, paper sliver, heavy line, paper sliver, thin line (about 12-15 px in all); all of it is street, and each block's side is on its own thin line. Alley names are printed INSIDE the blocks beside their alleys, not in the alleys (STEVENSON ST., JESSIE ST., TEHAMA, CLEMENTINA, MINT, MARY, HOLLAND, OPAL, TULIP, FAL-MOUTH, HU-BERT): the closed outline round each shows the lettering is in the block; it was ignored. Judgment calls (please rule): 1. Two blocks are each made of two pieces of paper divided by a heavy zoning border running THROUGH the block (no street paper, the block's thin side runs on unbroken across the border's end), so each is one polygon: (a) Tehama-Clementina between Fifth and Sixth, heavy border stepping down through it at x 1965-2000, y 4752-4830; (b) Tehama-Clementina between Fourth and Fifth, a single 7-8 px heavy line through it from (2210, 4610) to the box side at (2420, 4450) (its south-west side is one thin line (2208, 4570)-(2245, 4625) that the heavy line crosses at (2225, 4597)). Here the heavy border leaves Tehama alley at Fifth, runs 40 px down Fifth St and enters the block. 2. Dead-end alleys with paper between their two lines are cut out of their blocks as street: Latham Pl (x 1662-1716, y 3903-3908), Opal Pl (x 1577-1605, y 4244-4245, paper only about 2 px), Jessie St east of Fourth (from Fourth St at (2240, 4050) to its end at (2408, 3916)), Jessie St west of Sixth (from Sixth St at (1665, 4487) to its end at (1572, 4552)), Holland Ct (from (2338, 4350) to its end at (2270, 4268)). 3. Alleys printed with no paper between their lines are left inside their block (nothing to cut): Tulip Alley, a solid bar about 9 px wide from (1635, 4757) to (1672, 4730); the slot beside HU-BERT at (2391-2414, 4766-4800), two lines with a 1 px gap of paper closed off from every street. 4. FAL-MOUTH (2170-2215, 4800-4839): a second line runs beside the block's south-west side 3-4 px inside it, broken at (2191-2202, 4829); I read it as the frame of the lettering and kept the strip in the block; Falmouth St is then the 13 px street between blocks at (2134-2177, 4820-4839) and (2170-2280, 4760-4839). If that strip is the alley, it should be cut out. 5. Narrow alleys drawn as two thin lines with 1-3 px paper between (Mary St (1912-1950, 4410-4462) and its continuation 'ST' (1962-1990, 4468-4522); the alley between the blocks at (2100-2240, 4245-4350) with a small step at (2185, 4300)): the blocks either side stop on their own lines; the paper between is street. 6. Lettering over lines: C-M (2290-2420, 4065-4130) and M-1 (2345-2420, 4615-4660) lie across a street and a block; the sides follow the printed lines under them. The small pieces of street paper cut off inside the M of M-1 (2351-2365, 4624-4651) and east of it (2380-2420, 4590-4630) are street. Blocks cut by the box's sides end on the box edge.
